outcome: Three concrete defects reproduced, fixed, and independently retested. No unresolved blocker identified in the stated non-GUI scope.

findings.title: Schema-admitted mutation IDs poisoned subsequent manual Save
findings.details: Colon/dot IDs were accepted by JS but rejected by Rust v5. Permanent INVALID_REQUEST was retained as uncertain workspacePending, making ordinary Save retry forever. Exact grammar and explicit known pre-write rejection handling now avoid this.

findings.title: MCP history inaccessible beyond 100 saved revisions
findings.details: v5 produces up to 1000 rows, host rejected >100. Host now returns bounded 100-row pages with continuation based on returned tail. Independent real SQLite test enumerated all 1001 durable revisions without omission/duplication.

findings.title: Cancelled or closed async exports repopulated/evicted resource cache
findings.details: Post-await closed/AbortSignal guard now precedes artifact projection; close/cancel errors retain rejection semantics. Ordinary errors and successful exact resource/image behavior unchanged.

test_runs.name: Independent adversarial TypeScript + real SQLite/App callbacks/JSDOM
Existing real stdio Sidecar/SQLite MCP durability suite
Existing client CPU/WASM, app, bridge, scope and UI suites

limits: No browser UI/CSP enforcement, OS socket bind, GPU execution, or pixel equivalence was attempted or claimed.
Actual CPU raster verification uses real product WASM/export path with an in-process Worker message/lifetime adapter.

App integration executes the unchanged actual App.tsx effect body with real settings/workspace adapters and Editor/DesktopSession, replacing only React effect scheduling and native IPC; it is not a full App browser mount.
Existing actual-main tests replace Electron/OS/stdio boundaries; actual native dialogs/restart not exercised.

Generated app is local-only approximate HTML/CSS, with explicit session-only fallback; near-2-MiB state action failure preserves prior saved bytes and displays warning, while current-tab state may remain unsaved.
No exactly-once claim across editor/native transport/SQLite.
Panel enabled state is explicitly current-document read-only and separately displays workspace/settings grants. Enable button shorthand remains less explicit, but native approval enumerates scopes.
Hashes are the reviewed working-tree sources; later edits require affected reruns.
